rv.q: Mischievous makeover of Jerome K Jerome’s perennial classic from adapter Al Smith
Slapstick dominates in an engaging evening that smooths the jagged oddness of the book.
Funny, energetic and winningly performed, this busy adaptation loses its way whenever it reaches for insights beyond Jerome K. Jerome’s timeless original.

cn.t: Jerome K. Jerome's Victorian comic novel translates into energetic, fun theatrical entertainment with winning performances and playful staging, though the busy adaptation occasionally overreaches beyond the original's timeless charm.
